question: Indicate the correct option regarding the quality of life of a patient who goes through three consecutive health conditions with utility values ​​of 0.45 the first, 0.68 the second and 0.95 the third:

options.opa: The best quality of life corresponds to the third state of health through which it passes.
options.opb: The best quality of life corresponds to the first state of health through which it passes.
options.opc: The quality of life depends on the time you are in each state of health.
options.opd: The utility does not serve to assess the quality of life.
options.ope: In all three states the quality of life is very bad because they are values ​​less than 1.
